title: تخطيط متناسب
rule:
Applies when: When planning a change.
Match planning depth to uncertainty and impact; follow AGHR-041 for material ambiguity and document reversible noncritical assumptions without arbitrary file-count approval gates.
rationale: التخطيط غير المتناسب يزيد العبء أو يهمل الغموض المؤثر. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
